QuestInfo.name: Remembering the Forgotten
QuestInfo.0: The girl asks you to deliver the #btime capsule#k to Chief Stan. Grim Reaper Steve, however, suggest you let it be. He warns that dredging up memories of the dead after all these years may bring nothing but pain... But you really want to help the girl.
